notes.title: Angel Aniel's Campaign is Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905335/6ce1935250de3f6547e7290a3eb1a4c2b88b90fd.jpg[/img]
The grand new story of the Angel Aniel in “Girls and Blocks” is here, bringing you the thrilling conclusion to the epic battle between good and evil. Discover how the mysterious box will shape the fate of this captivating story!

[b]What’s New:[/b]
[list]
[*] Six new characters! The roster grows to an impressive 23 girls, each with their own story and unique narrative arc.
[*] All five chapters are now fully accessible, completing the saga.
[*] Enjoy enhanced gameplay with new mechanics and innovative blocks.
[*] Unlock breathtaking new corners of the paradise island to explore.
[/list]

🎮 Already own the game? These updates are available to you now!

💡 New to the world of Girls and Blocks? Grab the game with all-new locations and the latest updates at 30% off on Steam (10:00 PST).

New Mini Campaign Already Available:

Now we are testing the build and fixing critical bugs.

[/list]

We also have a world map in development, which will be updated in future versions.

notes.title: Release Girls and Blocks 0.4.0
notes.content:

Now there will be a lot of text in the game (those who don't like to read will be able to skip it).

So far we've only done Chapter 1, which explains the plot twist and the goal for the player.

We've also completed the Prologue, which is the opening comic. Where the hero finds the mystical box and its actions.

Now it's our turn to add dialogs with each girl in the level.

Fixed some bugs and added minor improvements. Including booster work, comic book, levels with colored stones.

Please write your impressions in the comments about our update and what improvements you would like to see.

We have a big list of tasks we want to implement in our game.

notes.title: Roadmap (Update)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905335/7fc00400c616755a3a00ab897ca8993459bca252.png[/img]
Dear Friends!!!

My team and I had 2 hours of discussions and decided that we want to present you a much bigger and better game in terms of content than we originally planned.

At first we envisioned to make a game with only 15 levels and girls we will undress. Also achievements and a leaderboard. And the current version was ready at the beginning of April, which we can release.

While developing the game, new ideas came to us to make the game bigger and more interesting. At the moment we have already added 3 boosters and 3 sex scenes in the form of a comic book, which were not in the original plans.

Unfortunately, it takes a very long time to develop a comic for each level. And to realize them all, we need several months.

We also decided to add to the game:
[list]
[*] A full-fledged game story
[*] A prologue that immerses the player in a mysterious story
[*] A game divided into chapters that will be presented like a visual novel
[*] Dialogs with each girl
[*] Different modes of passing the level (easy, medium, difficult) - dialogs will differ from this.
[*] A global world map, on which we will get acquainted with different girls
[*] 2 additional secondary characters
[/list]

If you like our plans, please tell your friends about our game or post about it on social networks. We are trying hard and your opinion is important to us!

[b]More game updates coming soon![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2874110

notes.title: The demo has been released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905335/9066bfa0dc41c3d980cd83734f61304d074eda05.png[/img]
Hi everyone!!!
Just recently we released a demo version of our new [b]Girls and Blocks[/b] game and you can try it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2874110

We would like to let you know that we will update our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2874110]demo [/url]a few times, because we want to hear your feedback and fix any bugs we find. We will also add new mechanics to the game to make it more interesting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905335/08ac6a42142a8355ccd243151a0296d65a6d6917.jpg[/img]

The longer we work on a project, the more we want to improve it and introduce new content that we didn't originally plan. Here are a few examples:
[list]
[*] Added boosters to the game
[*] Added level replay
[*] Updated the game interface
[/list]

We also plan to implement in the near future:
[list]
[*] Add achievements
[*] Add the leaderboard
[*] Add the comic at the beginning of the game
[*] Add dialogs with each girl
[*] Add additional characters for the main plot
[/list]

Don't forget to add our game to your wishlists! ❤️

[b]Our Discord[/b] - https://discord.gg/P6Kz94Qj
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905335/250f4fd3e172358608c19c7d92b490887e244ffe.png[/img]
